observations: Photo 0 shows a blue industrial gearbox with a shaft on the right and a large circular mounting flange on the left.
A label/plate is visible on the gearbox body, but the text is not clearly readable in this image.
No electric motor is visible in photo 0—only the gearbox.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a gearbox; no motor is visible, and the ratio/HP are not readable.
The ratio marking is not legible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Motor is not included or is a different HP than claimed (20hp).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the motor nameplate (brand/model, kW/HP, voltage, RPM) and a photo showing the motor coupled to the gearbox (or both items together).
risks.if_unproven: Price as gearbox only, and treat motor as not included.

risks.risk: Gear ratio may not be 1:10 (or may be different variant).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio/gear stage and input/output RPM.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic industrial gearbox with unknown ratio (worst-case for matching: assume not the exact 1:10 you need).

risks.risk: Condition/working status (noise, oil leaks, shaft play, bearing wear) cannot be confirmed from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox running (or a test run) and photos of oil level/condition and any leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (assume needs inspection/possible service).

risks.risk: Mounting compatibility (flange size, bolt pattern, shaft diameter/keyway) may not match your setup.
risks.proof: Ask for measurements/photos: input flange bolt pattern, shaft diameter, keyway size, and overall dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk (assume may require adapter/fabrication).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate (ratio, input/output RPM, model/serial).
Photos of the electric motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM, frame size) and a photo showing motor + gearbox together.
Video of the gearbox (and motor if included) running under no-load, plus a quick check for oil leaks/noise.
Measurements of input/output shaft diameters and keyway, and gearbox mounting flange bolt pattern.
response.reason: From photo 0 I can only confirm an industrial gearbox; the claimed motor (20hp) and the 1:10 ratio are not verifiable from the image. Missing these prevents a confident worst-case price.
